description: This is a Java test class for the ConnectionMigrationUtil, testing migration of connection configurations including authorization contexts, sources, targets, filters, and header mappings.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ConnectionMigrationUtil, focusing on migration and transformation logic of connection configurations including authorization contexts and header mappings.

methods.name: migrateConnectionWithGlobalAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Tests migration of a connection JSON object with a global authorization context, verifying all fields and authorization contexts are correctly migrated.

methods.name: migrateConnectionContainingSourcesAndTargetsWithOwnAuthContextWithGlobalAuthContext
methods.description: Tests migration where sources and targets have their own auth contexts, overriding the global context.

methods.name: migrateSourceWithFilters
methods.description: Verifies that the source's filters are correctly migrated and associated with enforcement.

methods.name: migrateSourcesWithoutFiltersJsonIsNotTouched
methods.description: Ensures that sources without filters in JSON are not modified during migration.

methods.name: migratePlaceholderTopicActionSubject
methods.description: Tests correct migration of header mappings containing placeholder variables such as '{{ topic:action }}' and related expressions.
